blockers.issue: The falsifier/registered metric set does not include the declared L3 collision statistic (or an explicit definition/threshold for it), despite claiming L3 statistics as leading indicators and describing L3 collision as an expected diagnostic. This is a scope/registration inconsistency, not by itself evidence against the geometry mechanism; clarify whether collision is a required registered diagnostic or remove the claim.
blockers.evidence: hyperbolic_necessity lists 'L3 collision'; falsifier.stage2_diagnostics registers L3_refinement_gain and conditional_G3, but no L3 collision. The frozen rule requires L3 statistics as leading indicators.

blockers.issue: The direction for L3_refinement_gain is positive with minimum_effect 0.01, but the supplied preflight warning says evidence expects lower and provides no justification reconciling the direction. More refinement (larger mean log2(b12/b123)) can indicate reduced collisions but can also indicate fragmentation; this direction is not mechanically grounded by the stated trigger. Revise the direction/effect rationale or register an unambiguous L3 statistic direction.
blockers.evidence: preflight_warnings[0]: DIRECTION_CONFLICTS_WITH_EVIDENCE, expected lower, actual curved minus flat > 0; diagnostic formula is mean_i log2(b12(i)/b123(i)).

reproducible_evidence.causal_link: The train-only directed transition counts motivate a testable hypothesis about content-derived SID prefix conflation, not a demonstrated causal next-item gain. Stage3 test_R@10 is correctly registered as final behavioral comparison (curved-flat > 0, minimum 0.005, paired seeds [42,43,44], all per-seed and arithmetic mean finite and above threshold). Null/missing outcomes are classified inconclusive; finite threshold failure falsifies.
reproducible_evidence.math_and_domain: Squared Poincare distance is well typed for projected 32-D vectors with c=0.1 and c||x||²<1; fixed-radius projection R=0.999 is within the ball. The stated c→0 distance limit 4||x-y||² is correct. Flat arm uses same fixed-radius projection and shared path, differing only in scored distance as declared. Fixed-iteration Sinkhorn procedure and deterministic rank hard-label rule are specified; no optimal-transport claim is made.
reproducible_evidence.loss_recomputation: Loss terms, nonempty domains, population sizes, target stop-gradient, codebook selection and Q gradient pathway are substantially specified. One caveat: full-set anti-collapse L_ac(I) is said to enter every minibatch, but gradient accumulation/weighting across minibatches is not operationally defined; clarify whether it is recomputed once per optimizer step over all N items or accumulated in a specified way, to ensure the declared scalar objective is uniquely reproduced.
reproducible_evidence.leakage_and_protocol: Training/assignment use frozen training item inventory/content only; validation pairs are diagnostics only, test only Stage3 final comparison. No future events or prediction-time user context enter Stage2. 32-D, 3x256, global SID, no sweep, paired seeds, 3000 epochs, frozen Stage3 protocol are registered.
reproducible_evidence.mechanical_falsifier: Finite paired outcomes and strict promotion floors are specified, while null/missing/empty/zero-denominator cases are inconclusive. The L3 direction and omitted collision registration prevent a fully coherent mechanical all-diagnostics decision, hence MATERIAL rather than CPU_ELIGIBLE.
